from solution import max_aggregate


def test_issue_example_from_description():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('Juan Whelan', 90), ('Sabah Colley', 88), ('Peter Nichols', 7), ('Juan Whelan', 122), ('Sabah Colley', 84)])
    assert result == ('Juan Whelan', 212)  # 90+122=212


def test_issue_single_entry():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('Alice', 42)])
    assert result == ('Alice', 42)  # 42


def test_issue_two_same_name_summed():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('Bob', 10), ('Bob', 20)])
    assert result == ('Bob', 30)  # 10+20=30


def test_issue_summed_total_beats_single_max():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('Ann', 60), ('Ben', 100), ('Ann', 50)])
    assert result == ('Ann', 110)  # 60+50=110 > 100


def test_issue_max_aggregate_at_end():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('A', 5), ('B', 10)])
    assert result == ('B', 10)  # 10 > 5


def test_issue_max_aggregate_at_start():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('A', 10), ('B', 5)])
    assert result == ('A', 10)  # 10 > 5


def test_issue_three_occurrences_summed():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('X', 10), ('Y', 5), ('X', 20), ('X', 30)])
    assert result == ('X', 60)  # 10+20+30=60 > 5


def test_issue_many_names_picks_largest_sum():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('P', 7), ('Q', 8), ('R', 9), ('Q', 8), ('P', 1)])
    assert result == ('Q', 16)  # 8+8=16 > 9 > 7+1=8


def test_issue_later_occurrence_makes_winner():
    """Calculate the maximum aggregate from the list of tuples."""
    result = max_aggregate([('M', 40), ('N', 50), ('M', 20)])
    assert result == ('M', 60)  # 40+20=60 > 50


def test_contract_returns_tuple_pair():
    """Maximum aggregate is returned as a tuple."""
    result = max_aggregate([('A', 1), ('B', 2)])
    assert isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2  # 2 > 1


def test_contract_public_function_callable():
    """Public interface provides max_aggregate(stdata)."""
    assert callable(max_aggregate)  # 1 argument expected
